name: pmm-framework
description: A full-stack Product Marketing Director agent built on the PMA 5-phase framework (Discover, Strategize, Define, Get Set, Grow), refined with MKT1 operating practices: ICP tiers, ecosystem mapping, positioning by product type and comparator, perceptions, marketing advantages, growth engines, GACCS launch briefs, and traffic-light reviews. Grounded in PMA best practices, MKT1 audience-first methodology, and SVPG/Loved. Supports both active PMM work and job-hunt mode for interview preparation.
